description: Deciding everything the model sees on each call (prompt, examples, history, documents, memory, tools, tool results), not only the instruction wording.
Quality degrading as the input grows, especially with irrelevant or distracting material, even well within the context window.
Models use information at the start and end of a long context more reliably than information in the middle.
The input tokens available for a call: the context window minus the reserved output tokens and a safety margin.
The four context strategies: store information outside the window, pull in only what is relevant, shrink it, and split work across separate contexts.
Summarizing a long conversation or agent session into a fresh, shorter context when it nears the limit.
Sending whole documents and full histories just in case: more cost, more latency and often worse answers.
